reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already owns the skipped-day check (isSkippedDay) and app.ts already imports from #shared/schedules, yet the server adds its own private isHoliday instead of exporting and sharing one holiday matcher.

duplication.why: The day / month-day matching (dayFromDate, slice(5), some(holiday === day || holiday === monthDay)) is written twice, once in app.ts isHoliday and once inside shared isSkippedDay.

placement.why: Holiday semantics belong in shared/schedules.ts next to isSkippedDay, but the server copy lives at the bottom of the schedules app module among service code.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but an existing test's frequency is changed from weekly to daily, an edit unrelated to recurring holidays.

maintainability.why: Within app.ts the two call sites now share isHoliday, which is an improvement, but a future change to holiday syntax must still be made in two modules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts isHoliday re-implements the holiday part of shared/schedules.ts isSkippedDay instead of using a shared export.

disguised_duplication.where: isHoliday in app.ts and the body of isSkippedDay in shared/schedules.ts are near-verbatim copies, not disguised.
